name: Shlok Vaishnav
role: Computer science undergraduate working on machine learning and quantitative research
bio: I am a computer science undergraduate at Nirma University, interested in machine learning and quantitative research. I work on statistical learning, mathematical modeling and efficient computation, and I want models and systems that are rigorous, efficient and empirically validated.

I am a computer vision researcher at the Space Applications Centre of ISRO. There I train a two-stage crater detection and segmentation pipeline on Chandrayaan-2 terrain models, which reaches 0.83 mIoU on lunar crater tiles.

I build systems from scratch to understand them: a distributed vector database with Raft and HNSW, a pre-registered statistical audit for neural architecture search, and an LLM inference engine with a custom Triton kernel.
availability: Open to internships and research collaborations.

education.coursework: Data Structures and Algorithms, Design and Analysis of Algorithms, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Database Management Systems, Discrete Mathematics
